t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Earthy colours yield more points, but experiment as sometimes this may change.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split into two categories: short hats and long hats. I found that the tall hats yielded more points. The gnomes are also split by colour: Earthly tones (brown, yellow, green) and others. I found that the Earthly colours could yield betetr points, but only if they were not up against the tall hats. I would always choose the tall hats, but if I was faced with two short hats, I would chose the non-earthly colours.
